title: Ranks follow SQL; `NTILE` gives the remainder to the first groups
description: `RANK`, `DENSE_RANK`, `PERCENT_RANK` and `CUME_DIST` give SQL's values over ties; NULL keys rank last ascending and first descending. `NTILE(3)` of 7 rows is 1, 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 3. `ROW_NUMBER` numbers ties in an order that varies over a table, though two equal windows of one query agree (`sample-row-number-ties`).
reference: SQL's ranks; `ntile_spread` to the first groups; `tie_order` any: native.

provenance.checked_by: sverify_dev.probe_snowflake through the Snowflake CLI (Snowflake characterization session)

evidence.sql: SELECT p, x, rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY x), dense_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY x), percent_rank() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY x), cume_dist() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY x), row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p ORDER BY x) FROM (VALUES (1, 1), (1, 1), (1, 2), (1, NULL), (2, 5)) AS s(p, x) ORDER BY p, x NULLS LAST

provenance.notes: `sverify_dev.probe_snowflake` runs each query through `snow sql` (Snowflake CLI 3.32.1) on an X-Small warehouse, Snowflake 10.40.102, with the session's `TIMEZONE` set to UTC and `USE_CACHED_RESULT` off; every other parameter is the account's default, recorded in the header of probes.json (`WEEK_START` 0, `WEEK_OF_YEAR_POLICY` 0, `DEFAULT_NULL_ORDERING` LAST, `TIMESTAMP_TYPE_MAPPING` TIMESTAMP_NTZ). The inputs are literal `VALUES`, except the `sample-*` probes, which read TPC-H's LINEITEM (6,001,215 rows) in SNOWFLAKE_SAMPLE_DATA.
